newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool prices remain fairly stable.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool prices remain fairly stable.

text.p: Australian wool prices remained stable this week, the Australian Council of Wool Exporters said on Friday in its weekly market report.
The eastern market indicator remained unchanged at 589 cents a kg clean. The western indicator fell six cents to 525 cents.
A total of 100,144 bales were offered, with 14.8 percent passed in.

The council said while prices remained largely unchanged with only relatively small movements in all categories, this was considered to be a good result due to lacklustre demand and the fact that this was the largest offering of the season to date.
In the futures market, a total of 155 contracts were traded in the 21 micron contract in the week ended September 19.
Wool International said it sold 18,060 bales, leaving the stockpile at 2,093,210 bales.
Sales next week are in Newcastle, Melbourne and Fremantle with 106,000 bales on offer. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
